name: Zoho Survey Free
free_limit: Unlimited surveys, up to 10 questions per survey and 100 responses per survey per month (also a 100-response annual limit per survey); 1 user.
watch_out: The 100-response annual cap per survey applies alongside the monthly cap; this is not 100 additional responses every month for the same survey. More questions, higher response limits, advanced logic and team access require paid tiers. Credit-card requirement and specific commercial-use permission for the Free plan are not explicitly confirmed; check before business use.
